tool.name: searchMessages
tool.title: List/search messages with cursor pagination
tool.description:
List/search messages with cursor pagination

Search archived messages after discovering accountId/groupId with listAccounts/listGroups. Check hasOpenGap before completeness-sensitive summaries. Prefer raw=0 and chronological time sorting. REST callers reuse identical filters, searchMode, sort and order with nextCursor until null when full pagination is needed; the stdio MCP adapter automatically aggregates chronological raw=0 pages up to its configured message/response budget and reports pagination.complete/truncated. Dates use the configured application timezone. semantic/hybrid first pages explicitly report whether vector search applied or fell back to lexical ranking and whether the bounded candidate window was truncated; candidate results are discovery evidence, not proof of full archive coverage.
每次只读一页，limit 默认10、最大20。继续时把 nextCursor 原样传入 cursor，保持账号/群/日期/查询/排序/搜索模式不变；nextCursor=null 才无下一页。统计使用 getMessageTimeline。
Harness 消息列表默认精简输出：保留完整 content、身份/时间/状态、引用锚点和附件键，省略头像、附件 metadata、重复引用树和逐条搜索摘要。detail="full" 可读取完整记录；精确读取某条详情优先 getMessagesBatch(keys=[{accountId,groupId,messageId}])。分页可能因24KB预算少于请求条数，检查返回的继续参数；禁止把未读完的页当作完整证据。

senderUid.description: Weibo user identifier returned in message senderUid or a user/member response.

Supports quoted phrases with \" escapes, AND/OR/NOT (or &&/||/!), parentheses, implicit AND, from:<sender> (for example from:user && "keyword"), and msgtype:<img|video|file|audio|link|emoticon|hongbao|system|recall|text>. Unknown msgtype values are invalid. NOT has highest precedence, then AND, then OR.

tool.description:
Create a keyword or sender monitor

Creates a rule in the existing background matcher and notification queue. Requires api:write. Set platform and discover owned target IDs. Supply keywords, sender UIDs or both. enabled defaults to true. Enabled rules may send future matching notifications. Existing history is not replayed. No archive messages are changed. tool.name: getNotificationStats
tool.title: Inspect owned notification hit and delivery totals
tool.description:
Inspect owned notification hit and delivery totals

Same rule/target statistics as the management UI, scoped to the token owner. Time filters apply to hit/job creation times, not original message time or failure time. Default last 24 hours, at most 31 days. hitCount is stored rule/message/keyword rows, not unique messages; sentCount/pushCount are notification jobs and successRate is null with no jobs. Queued/in-progress jobs can lower the observed ratio. No job is not proof of no match: quiet hours, throttles and disabled destinations can suppress enqueueing. Channels are capped at 100; narrow by platform/channelId if truncated.

tool.description:
Inspect recent owned notification delivery outcomes

Time filters apply to job creation time, not failure time. Default last 24 hours, maximum 31 days, scoped by owner and optional platform/channelId/status. Returns fixed failure categories inferred from server-side errors, never original errors, claims, payloads or credentials. A null category is unknown, not proof of health; a category is a diagnostic hint, not a confirmed root cause. Use monitor-rule hits/routes to distinguish matching, suppression and actual delivery. Paginate explicitly.
